content.value: A compressed air compressor has a first cost of 50,000 TK and estimated salvage value (10) [CO4] of 8,000 TK after 12 years.
i) Calculate the depreciation for year three using straight line depreciation.
ii) Calculate the book value at the end of year six.
iii) Plot book value vs time for the 6-year period.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
